lines.zh: 我一跳一跳，耳朵上的珊瑚在晃。
lines.en: I hop along, the coral on my ears swaying.
My hind legs are longer than my body.

lines.zh: 我跳上枯枝，珊瑚轻轻碰响。
lines.en: I hop onto a dry twig and my coral clicks softly.

lines.zh: 我停下来，鼻子动了两下。
lines.en: I stop and twitch my nose twice.

lines.zh: 我绕着一棵树跑了半圈。
lines.en: I run half a circle around a tree.

lines.zh: 我的毛还是湿的，贴成一绺一绺。
lines.en: My fur is still wet, clumped in strands.
One hop carries me over a small ditch.
The coral on my back clicks softly.

lines.zh: 我贴着灌木走，尽量不露头。
lines.en: I keep to the shrubs, head low.
I keep glancing back as I go.

lines.zh: 我的爪子陷进松土，很软。
lines.en: My paws sink into loose, soft soil.

lines.zh: 我朝着有草香的方向去。
lines.en: I head toward the smell of grass.

lines.zh: 我跳得歪了一点，落地打了个滑。
lines.en: I hop crooked and slide on landing.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵转向后面的声音。
lines.en: I swivel an ear toward the sound behind me.

lines.zh: 我每蹦几步，就侧耳听风。
lines.en: Every few hops, I tilt an ear to the wind.

lines.zh: 我的影子在草上颠着往前。
lines.en: My shadow bobs forward over the grass.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，把前爪收在胸前。
lines.en: I crouch with my forepaws tucked to my chest.

lines.zh: 耳朵上的珊瑚一颤一颤。
lines.en: The coral on my ears quivers.
I nibble a blade of grass.
Something moves in the soil. I hear it.
I wash my face with my forepaws.
My nose never stops.
The smell of the sea lingers in my fur.

lines.zh: 我把身子团成一团，暖一点。
lines.en: I curl into a ball to keep warm.
A bird calls far off. I do not move.
I flick my ears, one after another.
I scratch my neck with a hind leg.

lines.zh: 树叶落下来，落在我背上。
lines.en: A leaf falls and settles on my back.

lines.zh: 我在听风，风里有水的味。
lines.en: I listen to the wind; it carries water.
Coral grows on my feet.
You crouch down, so I stop running.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛在两侧。
lines.en: I look up at you, eyes set to the sides.

lines.zh: 珊瑚色的耳朵，听得见海。
lines.en: These coral-colored ears can hear the sea.
Both my ears point at you.
You reach out; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我不太确定你是好是坏。
lines.en: I am not sure whether you are kind or not.
My nose is working fast.
Are you going to catch me?
I lift a forepaw, then set it down.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就多看你一会儿。
lines.en: If you keep still, I will look a little longer.

lines.zh: 我疼得一跳，蹦出去老远。
lines.en: The pain makes me bolt far away.

lines.zh: 我歪倒在地上，又爬起来。
lines.en: I tip over and scramble up again.

lines.zh: 背上的毛夹着珊瑚，全竖了。
lines.en: The fur and coral on my back all bristle.
I curl into a ball and shield my gills.
My ears have turned to fins.

lines.zh: 我疼得直抖，珊瑚耳也在晃。
lines.en: I tremble with pain, coral ears shaking.

lines.zh: 我的一条后腿不太好使。
lines.en: One hind leg will not work right.
The sound I make is very thin.

lines.zh: 我钻进树根缝，只留一只眼。
lines.en: I squeeze under a root, one eye out.
My breathing is fast and shallow.

lines.zh: 我的鳃在动，是闻到它了。
lines.en: My gills twitch; I smell it.
I hop one step toward your hand.
I stretch my nose out and touch it.
I take a bite and back away.

lines.zh: 这块东西带着咸味，我喜欢。
lines.en: This piece tastes of salt; I like it.
Is there more? I want more.
My rabbit ears turned to gills, and still listen.

lines.zh: 我这么小，一受击就一定还手。
lines.en: I'm small, and one hit means I hit back.
I eat while watching you.
When it is gone I will dart off a little.

lines.zh: 你的靴底擦过我的珊瑚耳。
lines.en: Your boot sole grazes my coral ear.

lines.zh: 我被撞得四脚朝天，翻回来。
lines.en: I'm knocked onto my back and roll upright.
I bolt two hops away at once.
I am very small. Watch your feet.

lines.zh: 我蹭到你的靴子，毛被带起。
lines.en: I brush your boot and fur comes away.

lines.zh: 我停下来，抖了抖身上的土。
lines.en: I stop and shake the dirt off.

lines.zh: 撞得我鳃边的毛都竖了。
lines.en: The bump makes the fur by my gills stand up.

lines.zh: 我从你两脚之间钻到后面。
lines.en: I dart between your feet to the other side.

lines.zh: 我不是故意的，我跳偏了。
lines.en: I did not mean to. I jumped short.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我才敢探头。
lines.en: You step back half a pace; only then do I peek out.

lines.zh: 另一只从草里钻出来了。
lines.en: Another one pushes out of the grass.
We hop in circles around each other.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵碰到她的耳朵。
lines.en: My ear touches hers.

lines.zh: 两片珊瑚轻轻磕在一起。
lines.en: Two bits of coral click softly together.

lines.zh: 我们在树根下刨了个浅坑。
lines.en: We scrape a shallow hollow under the roots.
She runs, and I follow behind.
Squatting side by side, neither moves first.
There is grass enough to hide in here.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我们还在这一带。
lines.en: It is dark now, and we are still here.
She slips into the brush; I follow.

lines.zh: 我用牙叼住它，拖了两步。
lines.en: I take it in my teeth and drag it two steps.
It's bigger than my whole body.
Both forepaws hold it down.
Not food. I let it go.
I hide it under the leaves.
It rolls away and I chase it.
With this in my mouth I cannot hop.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把它拱到你脚边。
lines.en: I nudge it to your feet with my nose.
My ears have turned to coral.

lines.zh: 这味道不对，我丢下就走。
lines.en: The smell is wrong; I drop it and leave.
That one trampled my grass.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，耳朵向后贴。
lines.en: I flatten down, ears pinned back.
I have been struck before. I remember.

lines.zh: 珊瑚做的兔子脚，弹起来很快。
lines.en: Coral rabbit feet spring fast.
I am small, but I have teeth.
It is still coming toward me.
I bare my teeth at it.
This patch of brush is mine.
I am ready to spring.
My ears are already pinned flat.
I hop around it, looking for a gap.

lines.zh: 彩色的皮，在珊瑚间一闪。
lines.en: A flash of color between the corals.

lines.zh: 珊瑚耳转向它，一下都不偏。
lines.en: My coral ear turns to it and does not waver.

lines.zh: 它低头吃草，我后腿蹬紧了。
lines.en: It lowers its head to graze; my hind legs tense.
My nose is twitching.
The grass hides half of me.
When it stops, I hop half a block closer.
I am on the left now.
It moves slower than I do.

lines.zh: 草叶太密，我再钻近一点。
lines.en: The grass is thick; I slip a little closer.
I spring and bite its ankle.
My hind legs kick out, landing true.

lines.zh: 小牙咬住脚踝，立刻弹开。
lines.en: My small teeth nip an ankle and I spring away.
It stumbles over me.
Small teeth can still pierce hide.
I land and lunge again.

lines.zh: 我的身子在发抖，但我没退。
lines.en: I am shaking, but I do not retreat.
It backs off; I hold.
My ears are flat along my back.
One such blow is enough.

lines.zh: 我从灌木里钻出来，毛还湿着。
lines.en: I push out of the brush, fur still wet.

lines.zh: 耳朵上的珊瑚比昨天重了一点。
lines.en: The coral on my ears is a little heavier than yesterday.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身子，水珠四散。
lines.en: I shake myself and droplets scatter.
No sea here, but plenty of grass.
Sea brine in the wind. Nose up.
I crouch and look around.
Footsteps, far off.
I test the ground with a hind leg.
I hop forward twice.
I am not yet sure where this is.

lines.zh: 火苗碰到我的毛，我疯了一样乱跳。
lines.en: Flame touches my fur and I leap about wildly.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，耳朵磕在石头上。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and my ear strikes stone.

lines.zh: 水没到我的鼻子，我拼命往上蹬。
lines.en: Water reaches my nose; I kick hard for the surface.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被气浪扔了出去。
lines.en: A blast throws me through the air.
An arrow grazes my side.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光落在我身上，我动不了。
lines.en: Strange light falls on me and I cannot move.
My belly is empty; I can barely hop.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我四条腿一起僵住。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all four legs lock.

lines.zh: 脚下忽然空了，我一直往下落。
lines.en: The ground vanishes and I keep falling.
